Beef chuck slow-cooked with pearl barley.How to make it600g beef chuck, cut in 2cm pieces2 tbsp olive oil1 brown onion, diced2 carrots, diced2 celery sticks, diced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp tomato paste150g pearl barley, rinsed1.5 L beef stock2 bay leaves1 crusty loafBrown the beef in the oil in batches and lift it out.Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic, then stir in the tomato paste.Return the beef, add the barley, stock and bay leaves and simmer gently, half covered, until the beef is tender.Season well and serve with thick slices of the loaf.Building site egg and bacon rollsFrank brings Nada his paycheque. Fried egg and bacon on a soft roll.How to make it8 rashers of middle bacon4 eggs4 soft white rolls20g butter4 tbsp barbecue sauceFry the bacon until the edges crisp.Fry the eggs in the bacon fat until the whites set.Butter the rolls, add the bacon, egg and a good squirt of barbecue sauce.Hot lineConsume meatloaf with mash and onion gravyUnder the glasses the sign says CONSUME. Glazed beef meatloaf on buttery mash.How to make it750g beef mince1 brown onion, grated1 egg60g dried breadcrumbs2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce125ml tomato sauce1 tbsp brown sugar1kg floury potatoes, peeled80g butter125ml milk2 brown onions, sliced2 tbsp plain flour500ml beef stockMix the mince, grated onion, egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire and half the tomato sauce, and press into a loaf tin.Stir the rest of the tomato sauce with the sugar, spread it on top and bake at 180°C until cooked through.Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with half the butter and the milk.Cook the sliced onions in the rest of the butter until brown, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and simmer to a gravy.Rest the meatloaf, slice thickly and serve on the mash with the gravy.Back alley chilli con carne with cornbreadGlasses on or start eating that trash can. Smoky beef chilli with hot cornbread.How to make it750g beef mince2 tbsp olive oil1 brown onion, diced3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp chilli powder2 tsp ground cumin800g tinned crushed tomatoes400g tin kidney beans, drained150g fine polenta125g self-raising flour250ml buttermilk1 egg60g butter, melted100g cheddar, gratedBrown the mince in the oil, then add the onion and garlic and cook until soft.Stir in the spices, then the tomatoes and beans, and simmer gently until thick and dark.Mix the polenta, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter, pour into a hot greased pan and bake at 200°C until risen and golden.Serve the chilli with cheddar on top and wedges of cornbread.SweetsAll out of bubble gum ice cream sundaesNada is all out of bubble gum. Pink bubble gum ice cream and hot fudge.How to make it1 L bubble gum ice cream150g dark chocolate, chopped150ml thickened cream1 tbsp golden syrup300ml thickened cream, whipped4 maraschino cherries50g rainbow sprinklesHeat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir until smooth.Scoop the ice cream into tall glasses.Pour over the hot fudge, add whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry.DrinksSteel mill boilermakersFrank's steel mill went under. A shot of rye dropped in a cold lager.How to make it4 x 375ml bottles of cold lager120ml rye whiskeyPour the lager into 4 chilled glasses.Serve each with a 30ml shot of rye to drop in or sip alongside.Black coffee in a tin mugHe who has the gold makes the rules.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
